pt.h: Os timbisha shoshone vivem no vale há séculos. O nome veio dos garimpeiros de 1849 que ficaram presos ali a caminho da Califórnia. O bórax foi explorado nos anos 1880 com as famosas carretas de 20 mulas. Monumento nacional em 1933, parque nacional em 31/10/1994.

en.r: Vale da Morte National Park is a national park in the United States. It covers 13,650 km² and has been protected since 1994. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: The Timbisha Shoshone have lived in the valley for centuries. The name came from 1849 gold seekers who got stuck here on their way to California. Borax was mined in the 1880s with the famous 20-mule teams. National monument in 1933, national park on 31 October 1994.
en.ff: It is the hottest, driest and lowest US national park: Badwater lies 86 m below sea level, and 56.7 °C was recorded here. Even so it has dunes, canyons, salt flats, endemic pupfish in springs and spectacular wildflower blooms in wet years.
at: Racetrack Playa and its sailing stones

es.ff: Es el parque nacional más caluroso, seco y bajo de EE. UU.: Badwater está 86 m bajo el nivel del mar y allí se registraron 56,7 °C. Aun así tiene dunas, cañones, salinas, peces cachorrito endémicos en manantiales y floraciones espectaculares en años de lluvia.

en.r: Grande Bacia National Park is a national park in Nevada, United States. It covers 312 km² and has been protected since 1986. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.

en.r: Rye Patch State Recreation Area is a state recreation area in Nevada, United States. It covers 37.6 km² and has been protected since 1971.
en.h: A 2,400-acre (970 ha) Nevada state recreation area next to Rye Patch Reservoir, an 11,000-acre impoundment on the Humboldt River, 22 miles (35 km) northeast of Lovelock. Finds from Lovelock Cave show people camped along the river.
en.ff: Fossils of prehistoric camels and horses tell of the area's ancient fauna.

es.ff: Gobernadora y uña de gato; liebres de cola negra, lagartos cornudos y ratas canguro.
at: Paisaje desértico de las Newberry Mountains
